title: finding(devx): a path appended to a package's `test` script WIDENS instead of narrowing — `pnpm --filter @object-ui/cli test <one file>` runs all 16 files and exits 0
body:
Measured by the `#7807` dev seat while pinning `app-generator`'s two cwd-dependent cases (PR objectui#7810). Filed by the PM seat because that seat's two dedup channels were both down at the time (REST `/search/*` → 403; the single MCP `search_issues` fallback → `API rate limit already exceeded for user ID 318158314`), and it declined to file blind. The dedup was done here instead, over all 402 open items: no existing card carries this reading.

## Measured

```
$ pnpm --filter @object-ui/cli test packages/cli/src/__tests__/app-generator.test.ts
Test Files  16 passed (16)
Tests       246 passed (246)
```

The path argument **did not narrow the run** — it ran the whole package. The reason is in the script itself:

```
"test": "vitest run --root ../.. packages/cli/"
```

Vitest **unions** positional filters. The appended file path does not replace the script's own `packages/cli/` filter, it is added beside it, so every file the baked-in filter admits still runs.

## Why this is a trap and not a preference

It exits **0** and prints a green summary, so the invocation reads exactly like a successful narrowed run. An agent that appends a path and reports "the file is green, 246 tests" is reporting **the package's** count as the file's — the number is real, the attribution is not. Nothing on screen distinguishes the two.

The control that this is a property of the script and not of the invocation: the same file narrowed through a form that carries no baked-in filter is 41 tests before the PR / 43 after —

```
$ pnpm exec vitest run --root ../.. packages/cli/src/__tests__/app-generator.test.ts   # cwd packages/cli
Test Files  1 passed (1)
Tests       43 passed (43)
```

— against 246 for the same file through `pnpm --filter … test <path>`. Same file, same tree, one number is 6× the other.

## It is a third member of a family this repo already names

`scripts/vitest-invocation-guard.mjs` documents two invocation traps. This is the third, and it is documented in neither the guard's docstring nor `AGENTS.md` — both were grepped, by the dev seat and again here.

Related:
- objectui#7800 — `AGENTS.md` claims `pnpm --filter FIELD test` reaches the same conclusion as CI (falsified twice, `pm:awaiting-maintainer`). A ruling there that removes the baked-in `packages/<pkg>/` filter from the package test scripts would remove **this** hazard as a side effect, so the two should be read together before either is implemented.
- objectui#7329 — `parseVitestArgv` collapses a repeated flag to its last value, the neighbouring "the guard's own argv reading is not what vitest does" defect.
- objectui#7524 / objectui#7525 — the other two open cards on the per-package vitest invocation surface.

## Scope note

⚠️ No fix is proposed here and none is obvious: the baked-in filter is what makes the bare `pnpm --filter <pkg> test` mean "this package", and removing it is objectui#7800's question, not this card's. What this card asks for is that the union behaviour stop being invisible — a guard reading, a documented sentence, or a narrowing form that actually narrows.

⛔ Do not fold this into objectui#7800 by editing that card: it is `pm:awaiting-maintainer` and its sentence is a maintainer's to rule on.
